d: Discover the fascinating story of Baba Keenaram, one of the most influential saints of the Aghor tradition. From Kashi (Varanasi) to Kandahar and Hinglaj Mata Temple in Balochistan of Pakistan, explore the legends, spiritual journeys and historical mysteries surrounding this legendary Aghori saint. Did Baba Keenaram really meet Mughal emperor Shah Jahan? Did he curse the emperor, predicting his imprisonment by Aurangzeb? Discover the truth behind these stories, the connection with Hinglaj Mata and Bibi Nani, the history of Krim Kund, and the philosophy of Aghor. In this episode of The…
